title: NASA-UAP-D022, Gemini 9 Debriefing, 1966
doc_notes: This document is a collection of NASA internal memoranda and debriefing transcripts regarding the Gemini IX mission, containing brief mentions of astronaut observations of unidentified light phenomena.

incidents.summary: Astronauts observed flashing lights and sparkles during the Gemini IX mission.
incidents.quote: astronauts’ accounts of their observations of “flashing lights” and “sparkles” during the mission.
